title: Small work costs at most 2x a plain session
desc:
BN-3 (one-file chore) took 18 s and 208k tokens plain, 190 s and 2.12M tokens with workbench, same result. A dev who sees a 5-minute task become 15 drops the tool. The light tier exists (WB-44) and is not light enough. Frame: .workflow/idea-less-friction/frame.md.

ACCEPTANCE:
- on the bench, workbench/plain median wall time and tokens are at most 2x on the one-file chore and bug tickets, at most 3x on the feature, with hidden_pass unchanged
- the light path leaves no artifact the user has to open, edit or approve; guardrails (scope, tests) still run and speak only when they block
- the report's "where workbench loses" section is rerun and the README cites the new numbers
- rollback: a config key restores the current route
